previewBanner: Test version — not ready for real use.
quickExitAria: Quick Exit: leave this site immediately
quickExitShortcutTip: Tip: press the Esc key 3 times to leave quickly.
homeTitle: What do you need right now?
comingSoonBody: It will be added in a later stage of development.
dangerPlaceholderNote: Emergency call buttons will appear here in the next stage. This is a test version: please do not rely on it in a real emergency.
footerHonesty: Hifazat does not send police and cannot guarantee a response. It helps you find information and verified services.
tipsIntro: If someone else might check your phone or computer, these steps can help keep your visit private. Use only what feels safe for you.
tipsQuickExitBody: The Quick Exit button at the top of every page takes you straight to a weather page. On a computer, you can also press the Esc key three times. Quick Exit does not remove Hifazat from your browser history.
tipsHistoryBody: Your browser remembers the websites you visit. You can remove Hifazat from your history in your browser's settings. Deleting all history at once may be noticed, so you may prefer to remove only some entries.
tipsPrivateBody: In a private (incognito) window, the browser does not keep your history after you close it. In Chrome on Android: tap the three dots (⋮), then "New Incognito tab".
tipsSharedBody: If you share a device, close Hifazat when you finish. Someone who uses the device after you may see open tabs. Information you save in Hifazat stays on this device, so use those features only on a device you trust.
tipsHomeScreenBody: Adding Hifazat to your home screen lets parts of it work without internet. The icon will be visible on your phone, and saved pages stay on the phone.
tipsOutro: You know your situation best. Choose what feels safe for you.
dangerIntro: You are not alone. The buttons below call services directly from your phone.
dangerHonesty: Hifazat does not send police and cannot guarantee a response. Your call goes straight from your phone to the service.
placeholderWarningBody: These numbers are for testing only and do not reach real services. Do not use them in a real emergency.
numbersUnavailable: Emergency numbers could not be loaded right now. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
districtEmpty: No numbers are listed for this district yet.
districtPrivacy: Your choice is saved only on this device.
step1: If you are in immediate danger and it is safe to do so, call emergency services.
step2: If you can, move towards a place where other people are around.
step3: Tell someone you trust where you are.
step4: What is happening is not your fault. You deserve to be safe.
messageNoContacts: You have not added trusted contacts yet. You can add them in My Safety Plan. They are saved only on this device.
messageChooseContact: Who do you want to message?
messageDefault: I need help. Please contact me as soon as you can.
messageLocationHint: Only if you choose. Your phone will ask for permission, and the location goes only to this person.
messageLocationFailed: Your location could not be found. You can still send the message.
messageConfirmNote: This opens your messaging app with the message ready. Check it, then tap Send there. Hifazat does not see or send your message.
planPrivacyBody: Your plan is encrypted and kept only in this browser. It is never sent to Hifazat. Anyone who can open this browser on this device may be able to see it, so use it only on a device you trust.
planUnavailable: This browser does not allow private storage (this can happen in private or incognito mode), so your plan cannot be saved here.
planTrustedHint: People you can message quickly from the "I'm in Danger" page.
planPeopleHint: Friends, family or neighbours who can help.
planSafePlacesHint: For example a relative's or friend's home, or a health centre.
planTransportHint: For example a driver you trust, a bus route, or someone who can take you.
planDocumentsHint: Things to keep together or copy, if it is safe to do so.
planItemsHint: Things that may help if you need to leave quickly.
planDeleteBody: This removes everything in your plan from this browser. It cannot be undone.
